note: Surfaces the auditor is told to ignore. Every entry needs a reason — an unexplained exclusion is how a blind spot becomes permanent.

keyCodes.NumpadEnter: an alias for Enter in the name editor; the same code path, already covered by 03-lobby
keyCodes.Escape: covered by 03-lobby's name-edit tests, which name it in prose rather than as a code literal

netMessages.pack: the optional content-pack unlock, which needs an encrypted pack this repo does not ship

storageKeys.hs-name: a prefix fragment the scanner picks out of a template literal, not a key the game ever uses whole

platformFiles.src/platform/node.js: the headless entry — it has no browser to test in; test/ covers it
platformFiles.src/platform/debug-globals.js: the suite's own instrumentation surface; every spec that reads HS exercises it

renderFiles.src/render/content-pack.js: the optional content-pack probe, same reason as the `pack` message
renderFiles.src/render/effect-art.js: the vfx descriptor -> drawer table from the cosmetics-as-events refactor; test/vfx-descriptors.test.js asserts every kind the sim writes has a drawer, and 06-spells exercises the table on every cast without naming the file
